decision_question: Which governance program model and implementation boundary should replace the suspended whole-epoch ontology gate?
source: explicit user direction in the owning repository session

options.reversibility: candidate implementation can be removed before activation
options.owner_gate: separate exact activation decision over the finished program and runtime digests
options.meaning: Construct a Rust governance kernel that evaluates only the transitive closure of explicitly selected dependency records, treats unrelated epoch drift as diagnostic, permits exact candidate inputs in candidate-construction mode, and never activates itself.

options.rejection_reason: Whole-epoch currentness blocks unrelated work and creates a self-hosting deadlock when the runtime system ontology changes.
Removing relevance validation entirely would permit stale selected meaning and ambiguous dependency claims.

claim_limit: Selects the candidate construction direction only; it does not adopt a Governance Rule or Constitution, activate a program, bind an enforcement surface, or authorize repository effects.
